content.text: {"subject":"Math","mode":"concept","extracted_questions":[],"concept_explanation":"When you add 24 + 13, break it into tens and ones: 24 is 2 tens and 4 ones, and 13 is 1 ten and 3 ones. Add the tens together (2 + 1 = 3 tens, which is 30) and add the ones together (4 + 3 = 7 ones). Put them back together: 30 + 7 = 37. You can also line them up vertically and add column by column—ones first, then tens.","aditiApplicable":true,"aditiHook":"Think about it like money: if you have 24 rupees and your friend gives you 13 more, how many do you have altogether?"}
